question:
Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.

A war has been __unleashed__ on financial untouchability.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word in the sentence is **"unleashed,"** which means to release or set free from restraint, control, or confinement.(बंधन से मुक्त करना)
 
• In this context,** it refers** to starting or initiating the war on financial untouchability.
 
• The antonym for **"unleashed"** should mean to restrict, restrain, or hold back. 
 
• **Confined:** It means to keep or restrict someone or something within certain limits.(किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु को निश्चित सीमा के भीतर रखना या प्रतिबंधित करना।)

Therefore, the **correct option** is: **Confined.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Regarded: **This word means to consider or think of someone or something in a specified way.(माना)
 
• **Unchained: **This word means to release from chains or set free,(बेड़ियों से मुक्त)
 
• **Free:** It implies the ability to act or be done as one wishes.(मुक्त)
